items.questionText: Social media has become an almost unavoidable part of daily life. While it's certainly ___________ (1) to be able to stay connected with friends and family, there are also certain challenges. (Base word: DESIRE)

One major issue is the censorship that can occur on these platforms, which often leads to the ____________ (3) of content that may be considered inappropriate. (Base word: REJECT)
Some people feel that it is highly ___________ (4) that false information will spread rapidly, which may cause damage to individuals and communities. (Base word: LIKELIHOOD)
In terms of personal impact, the ___________ (5) of individuals based on their online personas sometimes results in an unfair judgements or unwarranted praise. (Base word: CLASSIFY)
On the brighter side, social media has facilitated many positive actions, such as raising ___________ (6) for important causes. (Base word: DONATE)
The logical ______________ (7) here is that while social media has its flaws, it also carries immense potential for good. (Base word: CONCLUDE)
Therefore, users must approach it with caution and a strong sense of ____________ (8) to make the most of its benefits. (Base word: MORAL)
